capabilities: Detect file and folder renames made outside Obsidian
Restore file identity, open tabs, and file explorer position after an external rename
Recognize renames made while Obsidian was closed on next startup
Offer to install Advanced Rename and Delete Handler for link updating
disambiguation: Not a bulk rename tool; it only recognizes renames made outside Obsidian, and since 4.0.0 it does not rewrite links itself — Advanced Rename and Delete Handler does that.
extras: Warning: detection relies on the file system preserving the file's inode, which not every file system does; the docs include a per-filesystem measurement section. The documentation itself is a demo vault, shipped with each release and openable via a command or GitHub.
intentEvidence: Alternative detection: inodes; catches offline renames too; delegates link updates
problem: When a file is renamed by a file manager, script, or sync client, Obsidian sees a delete followed by a create, so links to it are not updated.

relations.evidence: Advanced Rename and Delete Handler owns rename and delete handling for the whole vault.
Alternative detection: inodes; catches offline renames too; delegates link updates
Polls selected folders; adds externally created files
Polls for externally added/changed files; Flatpak/network-drive use

summary: Detects renames made outside Obsidian and reports them to Obsidian as a single rename so the file keeps its identity and links stay intact.
